notes: ASIMOV 'Here Be Dragons' is a fictional internal BlackCat Robotics prototype platform used for pipeline testing. All specs are placeholders with low confidence and do not correspond to any real hardware. Failure modes reflect generic early-prototype risks rather than field data.

failure_modes.name: Uncharacterized actuator firmware faults
failure_modes.symptoms: Random joint lockups, unexplained torque spikes, watchdog resets during testing
failure_modes.mitigation: Test only on stand/tether, log all CAN traffic, freeze firmware versions per test campaign

failure_modes.name: Wiring harness chafing
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent sensor dropouts, shorts after repeated joint cycling, error bursts correlated with pose
failure_modes.mitigation: Add strain relief and abrasion sleeving, inspect harness after every 10 test hours

failure_modes.name: Thermal runaway risk in unvalidated battery pack
failure_modes.symptoms: Cell temperature excursions, pack swelling, BMS overtemp alarms under load
failure_modes.mitigation: Charge/test in fire-safe enclosure, conservative BMS limits, never leave charging unattended

failure_modes.name: Sensor fusion stack divergence
failure_modes.symptoms: Pose estimate drift, controller instability, sudden balance corrections without cause
failure_modes.mitigation: Gate autonomy behind estimator health checks, run shadow-mode validation before closed-loop use
